name: Eval Lab
audience_feeling: The reader should feel that a difficult evaluation problem has become understandable and inspectable, not that they are being sold a miracle.
promise: Make routine judgments cheaper, make uncertainty visible, and keep a trace of why a decision was made.

preferred_terms.uncertainty: the cases that should move onward
preferred_terms.reproducibility: another agent can rerun or inspect the result
preferred_terms.technical_detail: explain it after the reader understands why it matters

good_examples: A polished answer can still contain one wrong assumption. Eval Lab makes that failure measurable.
Easy cases can stay local; ambiguous cases can move to Jev, a stronger judge, or a human.
bad_examples: Eval Lab is a robust, cutting-edge platform that seamlessly enables trustworthy AI evaluation.
Our revolutionary system guarantees accurate and reliable decisions.
